calibration: RGBA PNGs preserved without resize, crop, or pixel edits. Optical body height calibrated to about 56 worldpx from alpha>=128 body bounds; origin x is the alpha-weighted centroid in the bottom 50px of the alpha>=128 body, origin y is the last alpha>=128 row. Four independently drawn orientations; no flips. WebP runtime assets use lossless encoding and decode RGBA-identically to the PNG sources.
